title: Risk-minimizing reinsurance with adverse selection
abstract: arXiv:2504.17468v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive characterization of optimal reinsurance mechanisms under adverse selection when a monopolistic reinsurer faces a continuum of insurers with multi-dimensional private information on loss exposures and Value-at-Risk (VaR) preferences. Moving beyond standard single-dimensional or discrete-type models, we resolve an infinite-dimensional, non-convex screening problem by introducing a novel pre-reinsurance VaR reparameterization and an indirect utility representation. This framework converts global incentive constraints into tractable, typewise conditions. Using a Breeden-Litzenberger representation, we show that optimal indirect utility consistently adopts a hinge form across stop-loss, quota-share, and change-loss contract classes, yielding an endogenous market-exclusion threshold. translated_title: 逆向选择下的风险最小化再保险
translated_abstract: 本文全面刻画了在逆向选择情形下的最优再保险机制，其中垄断再保险人面对一个连续统的保险人，这些保险人拥有关于损失暴露和风险价值偏好等多维私人信息。超越标准的单维或离散类型模型，我们通过引入一种新颖的“再保险前VaR”重新参数化方法和间接效用表示，解决了一个无限维、非凸的筛选问题。该框架将全局激励约束转化为易于处理的、按类型划分的条件。利用Breeden-Litzenberger表示，我们证明了最优间接效用在停止损失、成数分保和变额损失等合同类别中一致地呈现铰链形式，从而得到一个内生的市场排除阈值。在参与市场的类型中，停止损失合同通过类型相关的免赔额进行筛选，而成数分保合同则诱导（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文通过引入再保险前VaR重新参数化和间接效用表示，解决了垄断再保险人在多维私人信息逆向选择下面临的无限维非凸筛选问题，完整刻画了最优再保险机制，并发现最优合同呈铰链形式且产生内生的市场排除阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves an infinite-dimensional, non-convex screening problem under adverse selection via a novel pre-reinsurance VaR reparameterization and indirect utility representation, fully characterizing optimal reinsurance contracts that exhibit a hinge form and yield an endogenous market-exclusion threshold.
